# Oghenekaro Samson Afigo (Afigo Sam) — Portfolio & Services

> Full-Stack Web & Mobile Developer | Published n8n AI Automation Engineer | M.Sc. Industrial Chemist

## Executive Summary
Oghenekaro Samson Afigo (also known as Afigo Sam or Sampidia) is a full-stack software developer, published n8n workflow creator, WordPress plugin developer, Solana dApp engineer, and M.Sc. Industrial Chemist based in Ilorin, Kwara State, Nigeria. He is the founder of Afigo-Sam Technology and co-founder of SamPidia. With 8+ years of commercial development experience, he has delivered over 15 production websites and booking/e-commerce platforms for clients across the USA, UK, Europe, Africa, and Asia.

## Core Technical Specializations

### 1. AI Automation & Workflow Architecture
- **n8n Creator Profile**: https://n8n.io/creators/sampidia/
- Published n8n workflow creator used by hundreds of automation builders worldwide.
- **LLM Integrations**: OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude 3.5, DeepSeek, and FLUX image generation.
- **Key Automation Projects**:
  - *AI Multi-Agent Content Pipeline*: Auto-posts trending X/Twitter content with AI-generated FLUX images and Buffer scheduling (https://n8n.io/workflows/14768-auto-post-trending-x-tweets-with-gemini-ai-images-flux-and-buffer/).
  - *Telegram Storefront & Payment Bot*: Turns Telegram bots into complete storefronts with Paystack/Flutterwave payments and Google Sheets inventory.

### 2. Full-Stack Web & E-Commerce Engineering
- **WordPress Custom Development**: Custom plugin engineering, bespoke PHP themes, MotoPress booking, Guesty channel management.
- **Payment Gateways**: Paystack, Flutterwave, Stripe, PayPal, and international payment processing.
- **Frontend & Edge**: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer, Webflow, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare Workers AI, Cloudflare D1.

### 3. Mobile & Web3 Development
- **React Native**: Cross-platform iOS and Android mobile development with offline data sync.
- **Native Android**: Published games on Google Play Store.
- **Solana Web3**: Smart contracts programmed in Rust; dApps including community-savings (Ajo/ESUSU) dApp (https://ajo.sampidia.com/).

### 4. Scientific Rigor & Industrial Chemistry
- **M.Sc. Industrial Chemistry**: University of Ilorin (2019–2023). Thesis: *Green synthesis of copper oxide nanoparticles using Luffa cylindrica leaf extract and antimicrobial activities assessment*.
- **B.Tech. Industrial Chemistry**: Federal University of Technology Akure (2010–2015). Dissertation: *Assessment of corrosion rate of dissimilar welded metals: gravimetric analysis*.
- **Peer Review & Publications**: Reviewer for IOPScience (*Advances in Natural Sciences: Nanoscience and Nanotechnology*); Author on Academia.
